name: LaserboyHolo (Travis)
description: Hologram making, handmade jewelry, experimental art blending science and holography. Behind-the-scenes creative process, glasswork, 3D printing, analog holography. Includes ISDH2024 reflection video.

name: HoloJay (Jonathan Ross)
description: Videos about holograms and holography, exhibitions at Gallery 286, exhibitions from the Jonathan Ross Hologram Collection, artists working with holography and light-based media. Features videos of holograms by August Muth, Dora Tass, Patrick Boyd, Iñaki Beguiristain, Steve Weinstock, and Matthew Schreiber.

name: TheDrlaser (Jason Sapan / Holographic Studios NYC)
description: Holographic Studios NYC content, hologram portraits, classes, 'Save Holographic Studios' campaign. Features Julia holograms and Canadian radio interview.

name: Eric Leiser
description: Holographic filmmaker — art exhibitions, animated films, music videos, performances. Features holographic sculpture content. Recent content includes 'Ethereal Grounds' solo exhibition (2026) and 'Ghost Stay' (2025). Also has holography-specific videos from 2005-2019.

name: Al Razutis — XAR3D
description: Stereoscopic 3D video, holography and holographic art documentation. Playlists include 'Holographics 3D', 'West-Coast Artists - Holographic Art - 2D'. Features holography of Fred Unterseher, Sharon McCormack, John Kaufman, and others.

name: Hans Bjelkhagen
description: 3D Imaging and Holography — Lippmann photography, digital and analogue colour holograms. Features 'Russian Egg', 'Watches', 'Monster' hologram videos.

name: Rob Hocking — Math Art
description: Digital holography for artists, fractal art, 3D visualizations, black hole holography visualization. Most popular video: 'How To Visualize A Black Hole Using Digital Holography' (22K views).

name: Josh Dellay
description: Holography, optics, lasers. Features Escher's Cubic Sphere hologram, Geola pulse laser content, hologram jewelry pendants, faceting machine modifications. ISDH 2024 tour video.

name: Rayvel Holographics
description: Rayvel ribbon cutting ceremony and dedication. Company focused on holographic technology for security, science, industry, and immersive visual experiences.

name: HoloCenter NYC
description: Exhibitions and projects at the Center for the Holographic arts. Features 'The Pure Visual Delight of Holographic Art' (3.8K views), 'Artist Photonics – light and art', 'Physics of Holography lecture by Pete Rogina' (56K views).

name: HiHolography (Hellenic Institute of Holography)
description: Promoting holography since 1987. Playlists include LightAlive2019 (Shanghai), LightAlive2016 (Moscow), LightAlive2015 (St. Petersburg), Educative Videos, OptoClones. Features historical holography content including 'Lippmann Denisyuk Holography' by Hans Bjelkhagen (1993).

name: Virtual Museum of Holography
description: HoloSeminar series — 'What is a Hologram?' panel discussions with holographic artists.

name: Holography at BYU
description: Holographic video monitor demos, rainbow holograms, stereogram GUI, color balance demos.

name: Imaging and Displays Research Group (De Montfort University)
description: Holographic data visualization, capturing laser transmission holograms, Blythtype cyanotype. Associated with Martin Richardson's research group at DMU.

name: singlemode (HoloTalk)
description: HoloTalk interview series with holographers. Features interviews with Hans Bjelkhagen (#110), Dr. Martin Richardson (#130), Nancy Gorglione (#133), Martina Mrongovius (#130), Dinesh Padiyar (#98), Ron Olson (#45), Paul Christie/LitiHolographics (#92), Sam Goldwasser (#101), Howard Kurs (#7), and many more.

name: LitiHolo
description: Hologram kits, how-to-make holograms tutorials, full-color holography, 3D hologram printer. Most popular: 'How to Make a Hologram' (48K views), 'How to Make Full-Color Holograms' (39K views).

name: River Valley Technologies
description: Primarily a publishing/technology company channel, but contains holography-specific content including 'Fine Art Holography in Transition — Analogue to Digital', 'Holography in the history of Contemporary Art', 'Installation with Sunlight and Holography', ISDH symposium recordings.

name: Jacques Holograms
description: Synthetic holography — 'The Perspectives of Synthetic Holography', 'Experiments in composition for synthetic holography', 'Content Metamorphosis in Synthetic Holography', 'GraphisHologram', 'Tractatus Holographis'.

name: Applied Science
description: General science/engineering channel with occasional holography content, notably 'Holograms on chocolate'.
note: Major channel — only download holography-specific videos, not full channel

name: Getty Museum
description: Art museum channel. Relevant for the Getty holography exhibition documentation featuring Matthew Schreiber's work.
note: Only download holography-specific videos, not full channel

name: OTA Contemporary (Santa Fe gallery)
description: Gallery channel featuring August Muth exhibitions. 'August Muth Holograms at OTA Contemporary', 'Message from Hologram Artist, August Muth', 'Please Stand By by August Muth'.

name: Martin Richardson
description: PhD in Display Holography (Royal College of Art, 1988). Holographic art including David Bowie hologram portrait, 'The Invisible Engineering of Holographic Illusion' (5.5 min lecture), 'The Crystal Skull Hologram', 'The Science and Art of Holograms' (30 min lecture), holographic capture systems, and multiple holographic art pieces.

name: HoloCenter (Vimeo)
description: Exhibition documentation from HoloCenter on Governors Island, NYC. Features works by Sam Moree, Geo Stadnik, Maximus Clarke, Nic Koller, Valeria Divinorum, Emma Hendry, Evan Voelbel, Ed Bear, Rita Jimenez, Shohei Katayama, Nooshin Rostami, Emily Allyn Andersen, Kamari Carter & Julian Day, Ioana Pioaru.

name: Al Razutis — Visual Alchemy
description: Decades of holographic art documentation. Hologram sales/lease pages, Sharon McCormack Collection & Archives, historical essays, critical writings. Links to YouTube channels (XAR3D, xalrazutis). Video embeds for 'Pearls Before Swine', 'Apsaras Projections', West Coast holography documentation.

name: Jason Sapan / Holographic Studios NYC
description: 45+ years of holography. Gallery/lab info, classes, tours, portraits. Links to YouTube (@TheDrlaser). NYC and Hawaii locations. Featured in NYT, PBS, Smithsonian, Bloomberg.

name: Jonathan Ross — Hologram Collection
description: One of the world's largest holography collections. Artist pages, exhibition history, lenticulars section, video page linking to HoloJay YouTube channel. 'How to Make a Hologram' (1993) video. Gallery 286 exhibition archives (now closed).

name: Martin Richardson (website)
description: Books ('Space Bomb', '2D 3D 4D'), holographic artwork, David Bowie portrait. Links to Vimeo channel (15 videos).

name: Eric Leiser (website)
description: Filmography, holographic works, exhibitions. Multiple YouTube channels. Whitney Museum inclusion, Kinoscope releases.

name: LaserboyHolo (website)
description: Handmade DCG holography. Portfolio, store, videos page, resources page. Links to YouTube, Instagram (@laserboyholo), Twitter, Patreon.

name: Joshua Dellay (website)
description: Holography, Optics & Lasers. Newsletter signup. Links to YouTube (@JoshuaDellay).

name: Matthew Schreiber (website)
description: Laboratory, work portfolio, CV, recent, archive sections. Getty exhibition technician.

name: Rob Hocking (website)
description: Mathematician and Holographer. Links to YouTube (@RobHockingMathArt). Digital holography, black hole visualization.

name: Ed Wesly Studio
description: ISDH 2024 organizer, holography educator. ISDH presentation pages, pedagogy materials ('Seven Single Beam Projects'), holography tutorials.

name: HoloCenter NYC (website)
description: Center for the Holographic arts. Exhibition history, workshops, artist residency info. Currently at 518 Broadway, Kingston, NY. Executive Director: Linda Law. Patreon, newsletter. Links to Vimeo (20 videos).

name: Holography Forum
description: The primary online community for display holography. ~51,000 posts across ~6,500 topics covering DCG, silver halide, optics, techniques, equipment, and gallery. Active since 2004 with Network54 archives back to 2002. Key knowledge base for DCG recipes, silver halide chemistry, laser setups, and ISDH symposium discussions.

name: Global Images Hologram Art Collection
description: Walter Clarke's collection of 34 artists, 89 holograms. Artist pages for Rudi Berkhout, Adrian Lines, Mark Diamond, Dominic Welby, Paul Newman, Jeff Robb, John Kaufman. Video pages with embedded YouTube.

name: Hellenic Institute of Holography (website)
description: OptoClones, LightAlive conferences (Shanghai 2019, Moscow 2016, St. Petersburg 2015). Links to YouTube (@HiHolography, 102 videos). Historical and educational content.

name: LitiHolo (website)
description: Hologram kits, 3D hologram printer, supplies. Educational content on making holograms. Links to YouTube (@LitiHolo, 36 videos).

name: ISDH 2026
description: International Symposium on Display Holography 2026. Symposium schedules, registration, presenter info.
